proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  letI : Nonempty F := ⟨0⟩
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_
  ·
    intro u hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u :=
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    refine hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) ?_
    rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    first |
      simp_all only [ModuleCode, ge_iff_le, InterleavedSymbol, interleavedCode_eq_interleavedCodeSet_of_moduleCode,
      interleavedCodeSet, SetLike.mem_coe, WordStack, Fin.isValue, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, bind_pure_comp,
      ENNReal.coe_natCast, gt_iff_lt]
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e (by
      rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
      assumption))
    apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
    intro r hr
    apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩
